decisions.reason: After only one year the market signal is still limited, and a software-based secure communication add-on is close enough to the firm's core capabilities that it is cheap to keep as an option.
A mobile PDF signature function fits well with enterprise security and document workflows, so the firm is likely to leave it on the market while uncertainty about adoption continues to resolve.
Although technically demanding, an end-to-end security architecture is strategically central to a mature German IT security provider and therefore worth maintaining despite early uncertainty.

This looks more niche and may depend on customer-specific integration, but because it is still early and the cost of keeping a software automation product available is moderate, the firm would likely wait longer before abandoning it.

A QR-code-based hardware token is less natural for a medium-sized software consultancy and likely carries higher support and operational costs, so with no clear evidence of traction the option is relatively more likely to be abandoned.
A payment-network security compliance suite matches the firm's established B2B security and consulting profile, making it a plausible option to retain while the market opportunity becomes clearer.
